verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents WebSDK permalinks that let applicants complete verification through a direct link to the WebSDK, and verification levels can be configured in plain language with the Summy AI level builder. That covers the core shareable-link flow, but the evidence never says an ops user can create and send these links from the dashboard without engineering, and QR codes are not mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit no-code dashboard generation and sending of links, QR code support, independent or hands-on corroboration.
